review_checks: Read all 136 nonretail paragraphs and every cited own-date headline, not a sample. Compared every quoted market field with the own-date card.

Applied actual UTC release status rather than treating nominal RSS timestamps as release certification; reviewed seven-day news/previews, fourteen-day results and thirty-five-day macro meaning windows.
Checked company roles, outlet attribution, headline-literal factual limits, actual versus pending, after-close timing, and expired preview handling.
Checked curve yields, bps, shape and move wording; exchange-local sessions and completed UTC crypto days; no numerical spot FX, suppressed levels or absent-listing metrics.
Checked financing versus plans, authorization versus executed buying, price moves versus flows, and the absence of invented ownership or social metrics.
Reviewed cross-section stances, conditional trade invalidations, meaningful section depth and all block word ranges. Retail keys were neither read as evidence nor altered.
limits: AI editorial review based on frozen headlines and market-card fields; no article bodies or outside factual sources were used.

Headline comparison cannot certify a complete original article or independently establish its publication vintage. Actual-release ambiguities are handled conservatively; automated verification is supplementary to the paragraph review.
